title: SkillInput
description: Top-level input to the skill. Normative human-readable contract: spec/03-input-schema.md. Validated at pipeline Stage 0 (spec/05-pipeline.md). project_context is REQUIRED: the skill is bound to the Samur project (spec/01-project-binding.md) and has no generic mode.

project_context.description: The Samur binding (spec/03-input-schema.md §1.1; spec/01-project-binding.md §1). Absent/invalid => input_rejection; no generic fallback.

narrative_period_ke.description: Default: 'post-KE ~900, the Dhaneshra Period equilibrium' (samur/02-canon/DYN-04 §15). PST-04 is period-sensitive.

method.description: e.g. 'canon-guard re-resolution' — never a frozen snapshot

resolved_at.description: timestamp/commit of the resolution; must postdate the draft's generation run

scope.description: the applicable branch state / file scope resolved

generation_contract_ref.description: the Canon Guard Generation Contract under which the segment was produced

drafting_constraints_ref.description: the drafting constraints in force (samur/00-audit/2026-08-28-initial-cross-check.md §4 or successor)

scene_canon_surface.description: optional pre-computed Pass A surface: institutions/places/factions/languages with canon IDs

text.description: The fiction draft. Plain text or markdown with explicit paragraph/scene markers.

author_intent.description: Absent => intent inferred from the draft only; intent-sensitive findings reported as author-consult-required.

analysis_options.description: Defaults defined in CONFIG.md §Defaults; overrides here must be validated against the config schema (CONFIG.md §Validation).

assistance_scope.description: drafting / revision / ideas; recorded for the author's own records
